name: hercules
label: Hercules obfuscator (v1.6.x - v2.0.x)
notes: Pure-Python static decompiler (stdlib only, no eval/exec/subprocess/network); never runs the payload. Handles VM, BytecodeEncoder and --maximum (nested) presets. Source-only presets (LIGHT/VRSECF: no VM payload) are refused with 'no VM or BytecodeEncoder payload found' (exit 1, expected). Watermark sits ~465 bytes in, after a polyfill header, so scan the first 4 KB, not line 1; a stripped watermark leaves only the weak (0.4) polyfill signal.
